num_nodes: <int> Number of nodes in the network, all of which are candidates for hub facilities.
num_commodities: <int> Number of origin-destination commodity pairs with positive shipment flow.

parameters.tau: <float> Interhub discount factor applied to the transfer leg between two hubs, reflecting economies of scale.
parameters.TC: <float> Transportation cost scaling factor applied to all Euclidean distances.
parameters.chi: <float> Collection cost parameter applied to the leg from the origin to the first hub.
parameters.delta: <float> Distribution cost parameter applied to the leg from the last hub to the destination.

nodes.x: <float> Horizontal coordinate of the node in the plane.
nodes.y: <float> Vertical coordinate of the node in the plane.
nodes.fixed_cost: <float> Fixed setup cost incurred when a hub is opened at this node.

distances: <list[list[float]], shape [num_nodes][num_nodes]> Symmetric pairwise Euclidean distance between each pair of nodes, scaled by TC.

commodities.origin: <int> Node index where the shipment originates.
commodities.destination: <int> Node index where the shipment is destined.
commodities.flow: <float> Volume of goods to be shipped from the origin to the destination.
